cues.text: Your soul is restored in full. Everything you spent, everything you traded away on the climb — returned. You walk out of here whole.
You will not receive the tenth tier. Not the knowledge of it, not the memory of it, not the ability to be told about it later by someone else.
You'll remember wanting it. That part isn't reversible. I'm sorry about that, it's not mine, it was written that way.
